purpose: Draft candidate transport-mode reference rows for a trip-planning application (how a traveler moves between two places).
scope: Only common, real-world modes of intercity/international travel. Do not invent modes that do not exist or are purely hypothetical.

fieldFormats.code: Uppercase, no spaces, must exactly match one of the allowed values listed below.
fieldFormats.label: Short human-readable label, e.g. 'Flight'.
fieldFormats.evidence: One sentence explaining why this is a real, commonly-used travel mode — not a citation, and never treated as independent verification on its own.

evidenceRequirements: State in one sentence why this is a real transport mode. A code is only marked verified here because it matches the fixed allowed-values list above, checked deterministically in Java, never because the model asserted it.
exampleResponse: [{"code":"FERRY","label":"Ferry","evidence":"A common real-world intercity/international travel mode over water."}]
